transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess what finally pushed me to come in is my appetite. It’s been really inconsistent for months. Some days I just skip dinner and I’ve lost some weight without meaning to, and other nights I’m just picking at crackers or cereal because cooking for myself feels pointless.
Have you noticed that you’re not getting pleasure out of things you used to enjoy, or that you feel unmotivated a lot of the time?

Yes. I still do some of the things I used to like, like watering the garden or going to book club, but it doesn’t really feel like anything. I’m kind of just going through the motions. A lot of the time I leave early, or I don’t even get started.
How long have you been feeling this way? Have these symptoms been ongoing, or have they come and gone over time?
It’s been pretty steady since my divorce was finalized. That was about a year and seven months ago. It hasn’t really lifted for any long stretch since then.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep lately, like trouble falling asleep, waking up during the night, or sleeping too much?

Yes. I can usually get myself into bed at a normal time, but I’ve been waking up around four in the morning. Then my mind starts going—bills, things from work, the divorce—and I just lie there tired until the alarm goes off.
Have you ever felt so down or hopeless that you’ve thought about hurting yourself or that life isn’t worth living?

I haven’t made any plan to hurt myself. But… yes, sometimes I catch myself thinking it would be a relief if I just didn’t wake up. That scares me, honestly, because if one of my clients said that to me, I know I’d take it seriously.
Have there been any times when you felt unusually energetic, needed less sleep, or felt like your thoughts were racing more than usual?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t had times where I felt unusually energized or like I didn’t need sleep. If anything, I’ve just felt tired.
Have there ever been a period of time when you felt really high, overly confident, or extremely irritable where you didn’t sleep much but still had lots of energy?
No, I can’t think of any time like that. I’ve never had a stretch where I was barely sleeping but still felt full of energy or overly confident.
Before this period following your divorce, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I’ve had stressful times before, like anyone, but I don’t know that it was for more than two weeks in the way you’re asking. Nothing stands out to me clearly before this.

Have you ever had a period of time, before this one, where you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks, and then fully returned to feeling like yourself again before another episode happened?
I don’t think so. I’ve had ups and downs before, but I can’t really point to a separate period like that where it lasted more than two weeks and then I fully bounced back before this.

Have you ever had a period of time where you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks, and then felt completely back to normal for at least a couple of months before another episode happened?

Not that I can clearly remember. I don’t think I’ve had a separate stretch like that where I was down for more than two weeks, then felt completely normal for a few months, and then it happened again.

Have you ever had a time before this current period where you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks, and then felt completely back to normal for at least two months before another episode started?

No, not that I can identify. I don’t remember having a clear episode like that before this, where I was down for weeks and then felt totally back to myself for a couple months before it started again.

Have you ever had a time before this current period where you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks, and then felt completely back to normal for at least two months before another episode started?

I really don’t think so. I know I’ve had rough patches, but I can’t point to a clear earlier episode where I was down for more than two weeks and then fully normal again for a couple months before it came back.

Before this current period, have you ever had a time where you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks, and then felt completely back to normal for at least two months before another episode started?

I don’t think so. I’ve had times where I wasn’t doing great, but I can’t recall a clear pattern like that—being down for more than two weeks, then completely back to normal for two months, and then having it start again.

Before this current period following your divorce, was there ever a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks, and then fully returned to feeling like yourself again for at least two months before this current period started?
No, I don’t think there was a separate time like that before this. I can’t really identify a period where I was down for weeks and then clearly back to myself for a couple months before this started.

Before this current period following your divorce, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks, and then fully returned to feeling like yourself again for at least two months before another episode started?

No, I still can’t think of a time like that. I’ve had ups and downs, but not a clear separate episode where I was down for weeks, then fully back to normal for a couple months before it happened again.

Before this current period following your divorce, was there ever a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks, and then fully returned to feeling like yourself again for at least two months before another episode started?

I’m sorry, I really don’t have another example to give. I can’t remember a clear separate period before this where that happened—feeling down for weeks, then being fully myself again for a couple of months, and then it starting over.

Before your divorce and the current period of low mood, can you recall any distinct times when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks, and then felt completely back to your usual self for at least two months before this happened again?

No, I really can’t recall anything distinct like that before this. I’ve had normal ups and downs, but not a clear stretch where I was down for more than two weeks, then fully back to myself for a couple months, and then it happened again.
